response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals and broad technical experience, they lack several critical requirements for this mid-senior embedded security role. Most critically, there is no evidence of native-level Japanese language proficiency (explicitly required). Additionally, the candidate's recent career has focused on high-level web development (TypeScript, Node.js, React) rather than embedded systems, security, or low-level C/UNIX development. The only C/C++ experience shown is from 2014-2015 at National Instruments (a lab IDE), not embedded systems. There is no demonstrated experience with Linux kernel analysis/modification, networking protocols, security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X), or embedded hardware control—all critical for this role.
strengths: Extensive software development experience (15+ years) with proven ability to quickly learn new technologies and programming languages
Strong understanding of software craftsmanship, CI/CD practices, and development infrastructure (GitLab, Docker, artifact management)
Demonstrated ability to work independently across full technology stacks and solve complex technical problems
concerns: No evidence of native-level Japanese language proficiency, which is an explicit requirement for team communication and technical documentation
Recent career trajectory (2021-2026) focused entirely on web development; no embedded systems, network security, or firmware-level experience
Limited and outdated C/UNIX programming experience (2014-2015); primary expertise is JavaScript/TypeScript and web technologies rather than embedded systems or low-level hardware development
